title: Complete lower-screen resource trading
summary: Use the current native Marketplace to select resources, review rates and totals, edit quantity, trade, reset and close from the lower display. Server rules, upper controls and other market modes remain upstream-owned.
preparation: Verify the exact candidate receipt, package is.xyz.vcmi.thor and APK checksum, then install in place preserving data. Use a disposable game with an owned Marketplace and several resource types; retain a route to an Adventure resource market if available.
limitations: Only resource-to-resource trading is added. Other market modes use their existing upper-screen controls. The lower deck publishes up to nine currently visible native resource rows with four rows per local page; unsupported or malformed states fail closed. Old Saves remain preserved and separate from Saves-upstream.

checks.title: Complete selection, quantity and trade journey
checks.steps: Open Town Services / Marketplace. Page the lower resource lists, choose Give and Get, compare names, balances and rate with the upper widget, use minus/plus one and ten, Max, zero and boundary quantities. Reset and select again. Submit one trade; repeat in the opposite direction, then Close back to Town. If available, repeat from an Adventure resource market.
checks.expected: Selections and slider match the upper widget. Different resources and a positive affordable quantity are required; exact preview totals and resulting balances agree. No wrap, duplicate trade or stuck pending state; success appears after the server result and Close restores the normal parent.

checks.title: Unavailable, changing and competing state
checks.steps: Choose the same resource, a zero-balance resource and an unaffordable quantity. Change selections/quantity on the upper screen while using the lower deck; try rapid repeated Trade and cross-control/held/dragged/extra-pointer input. If practical, change resources during a quote or exercise a server rejection. Switch the upper market into another supported mode and back.
checks.expected: Unavailable controls remain inert. Stale quotes and gestures cannot issue a different or duplicate trade. Pending disables edits; a server result releases pending, refreshes balances and reports completion/rejection. Other modes withdraw the resource deck and restore it only on return.

checks.title: Display and modal restoration
checks.steps: With a selected quote and while a trade is pending where practical, background/resume, toggle/reconnect the lower display and recreate the presentation. Open and dismiss an upper child/help window. Close from the lower deck, including while pending if reproducible.
checks.expected: Only current-revision data and controls return. No delayed trade, leaked window, lost parent, stale hit region or duplicate presentation. Closing preserves the native callback/lifecycle, and an already submitted trade completes under server authority.

checks.title: Upper input and neighboring deck regressions
checks.steps: Use upper touch/controller throughout trading, visit Town recruitment/construction and Hero management, return to Adventure and exercise existing lower Battle controls if available. Repeat resource trading with the lower display unavailable. Check accepted-action haptics with the Android system preference on and off.
checks.expected: Upper controls and single-display play follow upstream. Neighboring decks, extended Battle/player commands and parent restoration still work. No speculative success haptic for pending or rejected trades; accepted actions respect the system preference.
